applicabilityBasis.summary: Open USD is a U.S.-issued, dollar-pegged payment stablecoin issued by Bridge Building Inc. for payments, settlement and treasury use. Open Standard's launch disclosure specifies 1:1 USD mint and burn; Bridge's binding stablecoin terms provide redemption for one U.S. dollar, subject to user eligibility and compliance conditions.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN MSB registration and applicable state money transmitter regulators for Bridge Building Inc. (NMLS #2450917). OCC preliminary conditional approval applies to the separate Bridge National Trust Bank in organization, not the current OUSD issuer.
genius.notes: Authorization posture reviewed 2026-10-07 and not renewed here: Bridge's token-specific OUSD overview names the GENIUS Act, supporting issuer-announced intent rather than statutory compliance or official authorization. Bridge Building Inc. remains the named current issuer; the separate Bridge National Trust Bank in organization and its preliminary conditional charter approval do not establish current OUSD prudential supervision or PPSI approval. Issuer pathway stays unknown. Binding BBI terms provide eligible-user redemption subject to onboarding, compliance and processing conditions. Reserve-attestation posture re-reviewed 2026-11-01: the dashboard links one EY independent examination of the August 31 pre-launch book, signed October 1, and Bridge documents independent attestations as quarterly and optional. Open Standard's announced monthly attestations remain unpublished (the September and October monthly-named URLs returned 404), so neither a single pre-launch report nor a promise is a published monthly series; monthlyAttestationPresent is false. Canonical report dates are authored only in proofOfReserves.latestReport; no current holdings or authorization claim is inferred from the report. DASP posture remains the prior pre-effective finding, and no enforcement-history or primary-regulator assignment is added.
